answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is staked attestation: every new agent must be vouched for by several established, unrelated peers before its work pays out. Like an ivory carving passed around for expert inspection, each answer sits on a ledge of reputational collateral. If a swarm of fake comet-fast identities floods in, they cannot self-attest, so the cost of spinning up sybils exceeds any reward, keeping the economy honest.
